evidence_only_confirmation.purpose: Supplementary confirmation of evidence-only (controller-pipeline) cases on the release builds. These plain runs are not ledger evidence: deferrals.py accepts evidence-only cases only with primary-qualified controller receipts.

evidence_only_confirmation.frozen_only_reason: their cases need controller-provided guards, native controls or historical helper bytes and stop before behavioral execution in the plain runtime (ERROR, identical on all four builds)
evidence_only_confirmation.frozen_only_source_check: None of their sources (bashclock, bashsyslogd, cluster, mlock, ncdu, pty, ptybroker, top, uclampset, watch) changed after the freeze. dns.c changed (DoH response header indexes a8f0ec61, client NXDOMAIN retry 1453fabd); the dns/dns-authoritative-service evidence exercises UDP response rate limiting, which neither change touches.
evidence_only_confirmation.release_candidate_reruns: The plain variants ran on each of the three release candidates; case statuses are identical on all three, so the counts and changes above hold for the release binaries.

scope: The migration review was executed on frozen candidates built before the release source; every selected case was then re-run on both release binaries in disposable guests, and each frozen-to-release topic change is listed with its cause.
Topic results count reviewed scenarios, not cases; static and dynamic totals cover the same topics and must not be added.
Requirements listed as concrete limits stay unresolved; a limit is neither a pass nor a failure.

Evidence-only topics whose controller pipelines cannot be re-run rest on frozen-candidate evidence; frozen_only_source_check lists the source changes after the freeze and why that evidence does not exercise them.
These results do not establish complete Bash or GNU command conformance.
